_comment: Bundle-size budgets enforced by scripts/bundle-size/monitor.mjs. All sizes are KiB of gzip-compressed bytes. `total.maxJsCssKb` caps every .js/.css file under .next/static (initial + lazy chunks). Route budgets cap each route's first-load JS+CSS; a route not listed in `routes` falls back to `defaultRoute`. `maxCssKb` only applies where per-route CSS is measurable (webpack app-build-manifest); Turbopack route stats only attribute .js chunks, so CSS is enforced globally there. Values are ceil(baseline * 1.25), matching scripts/check-client-bundle.mjs baselines (2026-11-20): global JS+CSS 914.2 KB gzip, worst-route initial JS+CSS 449.3 KB gzip, worst-route CSS 34.3 KB gzip. Revisit after major dependency or routing changes.

regression._comment: Warn (do not fail) when a route or the total grows by more than this percent versus the previous history snapshot.
